name: 82 mm battalion mortar of 1937
about: Made by tools/battle-models (prop). Metres; x forward, y right, z up. A battle model: `part` says which part each point belongs to; `parts` are the parts (parent, pivot, axis of turning, way of sliding); `sockets` are named places for flash, smoke, fire and wake; `clips` move the parts. Turns: +t degrees about an axis carries p to p cos t + (axis x p) sin t + axis (axis . p)(1 - cos t), about the part's pivot. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 shade, 3 track, 4 rubber, 5 steel, 6 bright, 7 wood, 8 canvas, 9 glass, 10 black, 11 rust, 12 lamp, 13 white, 14 red, 15 yellow, 16 blue, 17 leather, 18 torn, 19 rope, 20 cloth, 21 skin, 22 brass, 23 link, 24 mount, 25 box

parts.name: mortar
parts.note: on the ground under the tube's foot (the baseplate's socket); the game places it

parts.name: tube
parts.note: the tube on its ball foot (rest: 62 degrees up): + steeper; and what is carried on a shoulder

sockets.name: sight
sockets.note: the sight on the collar's left: the gunner's eye comes to it from behind

sockets.name: grip.traverse
sockets.note: the traversing handwheel at the collar's right end

sockets.name: grip.elevate
sockets.note: the elevating crank under the yoke, at the right

sockets.name: rounds
sockets.note: the bombs laid ready: the number two's hand takes the next from here

sockets.name: seat
sockets.note: the gunner's root: kneeling at her left, his eye over the sight, his right hand to the collar

sockets.name: seat.loader
sockets.note: the number two's root: kneeling at her right, facing the muzzle, a bomb in his hands

sockets.name: muzzle
sockets.note: the muzzle: the bomb is dropped in here, and the flash and the smoke come out

elevate.what: the tube's lay (rest 62 degrees up; + steeper). The bipod is drawn for the rest lay: a change of a few degrees reads true, more wants the bipod moved

gunner.what: the gunner kneels at her left, his eye to the sight (socket sight); the number two kneels at her right (seat.loader) and drops each bomb in at the muzzle, then ducks away with his hands to his ears

fire.what: a bomb every 3 to 4 seconds when she fires for effect; one to range first. A thump, a ring of dust at the baseplate, a puff of grey smoke at the muzzle (no long flash by day)

carry.what: when the team moves: the game shows the `tube` part alone on the gunner's shoulder and puts the baseplate and bipod away until the number two and the bearers have clips that carry them
